experiment_analysis.qualitative_case_order: Descending maximum per-review issue-score L1 difference, then number of core field disagreements, then ID.
experiment_analysis.scope: One matched development run per arm; synthetic/stress results and historical pilot are separate.

selection.method: lowest seeded hashes of eligible original IDs

group_accounting.interpretation: Named groups are reported separately. Pooled metrics are descriptive of supplied records, not a population estimate; no design weights are assumed.

limitations: No implicit golden-label file is read; provenance is an explicit caller attestation.
AI-reference and candidate agreement are not human accuracy.
Structural quote/entity checks do not establish semantic label correctness.
No candidate selection or automatic expansion is performed.

paired_reference_differences.sampling: Same exact-text cluster draws for each side of every difference.

uncertainty.bootstrap_interval_policy: Bounds require at least two contributing exact-text clusters, 100 requested and defined resamples, and nondegenerate resamples. Empirical ranges remain diagnostic only.
uncertainty.limits: Intervals describe sampling uncertainty under exchangeable text clusters, not reference correctness or population representativeness.
uncertainty.wilson_scope: IID diagnostic; repeated texts require dependence-aware interpretation. Use cluster bounds only when their per-metric reportable flag is true.
